source_name: Министерство за информатичко општество и администрација (МИОА) — legacy site
why_relevant: Predecessor of MDT (until 2024). Holds the historical archive of state IT tenders, interoperability platform and e-government contracts — essential baseline for multi-year vendor/spend trend analysis in this cell.

source_name: KIBSTrust — качествени сертификати / trust services arm of KIBS
why_relevant: KIBS's certification-authority business. Signals demand for PKI, qualified e-signature and authentication technology — a procurement-adjacent line in the payments rails cluster.

source_name: Централен депозитар за хартии од вредност АД Скопје (ЦДХВ)
why_relevant: National CSD — the securities settlement rail. Corporate site plus its member/holder portal document the registration and settlement systems in use; a system replacement here is a major payments-infrastructure opportunity.

source_name: Македонска берза — профил на издавач CDHV (mse.mk)
why_relevant: CDHV is a listed issuer, so the stock exchange carries its mandatory disclosures: annual reports, shareholder-meeting materials and price-sensitive announcements. This is the practical way to see CDHV's IT investment/capex intentions, since it publishes no tender portal.

source_name: Влада на РСМ — Јавни набавки (централна страница)
why_relevant: Government-level procurement page and ministry directory; useful for enumerating contracting authorities and finding each ministry's procurement subpage, including MDT's.

source_name: ECEPP — EBRD Client E-Procurement Portal (North Macedonia notices)
why_relevant: Donor-funded infrastructure and PIU consultancy tenders in North Macedonia run through ECEPP rather than ЕСЈН. Payments/digital-government modernisation financed by EBRD would surface here first.

source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations — procurement plans and notices, North Macedonia
why_relevant: World Bank procurement plans for MK projects are published as machine-readable documents naming packages, methods and estimated values — including public financial management and digital government components years before national tendering.

source_name: TED / EU Publications Office — public procurement details (IPA-funded MK contracts)
why_relevant: EU-funded (IPA) technical assistance for North Macedonia's digital government and procurement systems is tendered through EU instruments; a procurement-detail record was observed in search results. Reveals EU vendors working on MK state IT.

source_name: Interoperable Europe Portal — NIFO country factsheet, North Macedonia
why_relevant: Annual EU factsheet describing North Macedonia's interoperability platform, e-services and digital-government governance. Excellent context/actor map and identifies capability gaps that translate into future procurement.

source_name: Слободен пристап (slobodenpristap.mk) — FOI request platform
why_relevant: Public FOI ('слободен пристап до информации од јавен карактер') request platform with per-institution pages, including ДКЖЈН. Both an archive of already-released documents and a lawful channel to request procurement documentation that is not proactively published.

source_name: CompanyWall / ABV.mk — company registry aggregators (КИБС АД Скопје)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregators of Central Registry data: legal identity, ownership, financials and addresses for KIBS, CDHV and their suppliers. Used to resolve aliases and to size the counterparties.

source_name: ЕСЈН — Електронски систем за јавни набавки (e-nabavki.gov.mk) Public Access portal
source_subtype: national e-procurement portal / statutory notice register
why_relevant: Single national statutory publication point for every contracting authority in scope of this cell — Град Скопје and the other 80+ municipalities, ЈСП Скопје, ЈП Водовод и канализација Скопје, АД ЕСМ, АД МЕПСО and municipal ЈП/ЈКП. Any tender for наплата на сметки, ПОС терминали, платен промет, cash-in-transit or e-payment integration by these buyers must appear here as an оглас and later as известување за склучен договор.

source_name: ЕСЈН Open Data — договори и постапки (open data / visualisation layer of e-nabavki)
why_relevant: Structured, queryable view of concluded contracts by institution, value, procedure type and e-auction usage — the fastest way to size the payments/collection spend of state-owned utilities and municipalities over time and to identify incumbent suppliers of POS/collection/CIT services.

source_name: Град Скопје — Сектор за јавни набавки (official city portal)
why_relevant: The largest single municipal buyer in MK. Its procurement sector prepares and publishes all city notices; contact channel javninabavki@skopje.gov.mk. Skopje is also the buyer behind parking, public transport and communal-fee collection arrangements.

source_name: Град Скопје — Сектор за даноци и комунални такси (revenue collection department)
why_relevant: Describes how the City actually collects public revenues, including collection at counters and via POS terminals — i.e. the operational demand that generates acquiring, terminal and cash-handling procurement. Useful for reading intent ahead of a formal tender.

source_name: АД ЕСМ — Јавни набавки / Преглед на сите јавни набавки
why_relevant: State-owned power producer, one of the largest state enterprise buyers. Publishes its own procurement and public-auction notices in parallel with ЕСЈН, including service procurements (banking/payment services, security, cash handling) alongside energy purchases.

source_name: А.Д. МЕПСО — Тендери / Објавени огласи
why_relevant: State transmission system operator; publishes annual procurement plan, published notices, concluded contracts and realised contracts — an unusually complete buyer-side dataset that reveals both upcoming demand (годишен план) and incumbent suppliers.

source_name: ЈП Водовод и канализација — Скопје (official site, procurement & finance sector)
why_relevant: Municipal water utility of Skopje — a mass-billing buyer with hundreds of thousands of accounts. Its accounting/procurement sector is the counterparty for billing, collection, card-acquiring and cash-handling contracts.

source_name: ЈП Водовод и канализација Скопје — е-плаќање / 'Плати брзо' и Мој Водовод
why_relevant: Live card-payment front end of a major municipal biller (Visa/Maestro/Mastercard, no-commission instant payment). Reveals the acquiring/PSP arrangement in place and any change of provider — a leading signal that a payments contract has been re-tendered.

source_name: ЈСП Скопје — електронска картичка 'Скопска' и мобилна наплата (public transport ticketing)
why_relevant: Public transport fare collection is one of the largest municipal card/mobile payment estates in MK: electronic card 'Скопска', virtual card, mobile app validation, top-up network, and mobile-operator ticket channels (e.g. A1 JSP bilet). Changes here almost always follow a JSP/City tender for ticketing, validators or payment processing.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — Е-јавни набавки section
why_relevant: System owner's page; announces policy changes such as the publication of signed contracts on ЕСЈН, which materially changes what can be collected about municipal and utility payment contracts.

source_name: WBIF — Tenders & Opportunities (Western Balkans Investment Framework)
why_relevant: Aggregates grant-financed procurement for MK municipal and utility infrastructure (water, heating, transport) across IFIs — a second non-ЕСЈН channel for the same buyers, and a forward view via project pipelines.

source_name: Снабдување со топлина Балкан Енерџи (БЕГ) — известувања и BegEPay
why_relevant: Skopje district-heating supplier and a mass biller with a large arrears problem; operates the BegEPay electronic bill-payment platform. Although privately held (so not an ЕСЈН contracting authority in the usual sense), it is a regulated public-service biller whose payment-channel choices shape the Skopje collection market — and a comparator to state-owned billers.
